faults.title: Manual-petrol clutch pressure plate fault
faults.description: On some petrol Mk2 Kugas with a manual gearbox, a faulty clutch pressure plate can cause a burning clutch smell. Stop using a car with this symptom and check whether the relevant recall repair was done.

faults.title: Tailgate-catch knocking
faults.description: A knock from the rear of a Mk2 Kuga can come from the tailgate catch. Check the catch and surrounding fittings before attributing the sound to the suspension.
